title: A set on which p_T is co-Lipschitz lies in one Lipschitz image of ℝⁿ (Simon Ch. 3, proof of 1.6, Lipschitz graphs; Ch. 2, 1.2)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, T a linear subspace of ℝ^P with dim T = n, D ⊆ ℝ^P and C ∈ ℝ such that |y − x| ≤ C|p_T(y − x)| for all x, y ∈ D. Then there is a Lipschitz map F : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P with D ⊆ F(ℝⁿ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (D : Set (Euclid P)) (C : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ T = n → (∀ x ∈ D, ∀ y ∈ D, ‖y - x‖ ≤ C * ‖T.starProjection (y - x)‖) → ∃ F : Euclid n → Euclid P, (∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K F) ∧ D ⊆ range F
